# Segurança e Operação
Fonte: appi-carsync-dev / law-carsync-dev. Horários UTC. Contagens estimadas usam ItemCount; latência usa registros observados e pode ser afetada por sampling. Ausência de dados não comprova saúde.

Mobile, IoT e ML: fontes não conectadas neste painel. Alertas existentes não são alterados nem representados como resolvidos. Dados HTTP de login/MFA não comprovam alteração concluída no domínio.

content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where _ResourceId =~ '/subscriptions/7fd8132e-7c9a-4b4d-a191-04b21ecc968c/resourceGroups/carsync-dev/providers/microsoft.insights/components/appi-carsync-dev' | extend Weight=coalesce(ItemCount, 1) | extend Path=tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)
| extend Rota=case(
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/leads/-?[0-9]+/convert$", "/api/v1/leads/{id}/convert",
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/leads/-?[0-9]+$", "/api/v1/leads/{id}",
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/customers/-?[0-9]+/360$", "/api/v1/customers/{id}/360",
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/churn/customers/-?[0-9]+/recalculate$", "/api/v1/churn/customers/{id}/recalculate",
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/churn/customers/-?[0-9]+$", "/api/v1/churn/customers/{id}",
 Path matches regex @"^/api/v1/vehicle-assistant/interactions/-?[0-9]+$", "/api/v1/vehicle-assistant/interactions/{id}",
 Path in ("/api/v1/auth", "/api/v1/auth/refresh", "/api/v1/auth/forgot-password", "/api/v1/auth/reset-password", "/api/v1/auth/change-password", "/api/v1/auth/mfa/enable", "/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify", "/api/v1/auth/mfa/disable", "/api/v1/user", "/api/v1/user/me", "/api/v1/leads", "/api/v1/churn/risk-list", "/api/v1/stock/alerts", "/api/v1/analytics/overview", "/api/v1/analytics/service-share", "/api/v1/analytics/customers", "/api/v1/analytics/leads", "/api/v1/analytics/vehicles", "/api/v1/vehicle-assistant/interactions", "/api/v1/health"), Path,
 "Outras rotas (ocultadas)") | where toint(ResultCode) between (400 .. 599) | summarize Estimativa=sum(Weight), Registros=count() by Rota, ResultCode | top 20 by Estimativa desc
content.title: Rotas com erros HTTP (4xx e 5xx)
content.noDataMessage: Sem registros no período e escopo selecionados; isso não comprova ausência de incidentes.

content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where _ResourceId =~ '/subscriptions/7fd8132e-7c9a-4b4d-a191-04b21ecc968c/resourceGroups/carsync-dev/providers/microsoft.insights/components/appi-carsync-dev' | extend Weight=coalesce(ItemCount, 1) | extend Path=tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)
| extend Acao=case(Path == "/api/v1/auth", "LOGIN_HTTP", Path == "/api/v1/auth/change-password", "PASSWORD_CHANGE_HTTP", Path == "/api/v1/auth/reset-password", "PASSWORD_RESET_HTTP", Path in ("/api/v1/auth/mfa/enable", "/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify", "/api/v1/auth/mfa/disable"), "MFA_HTTP", "")
| where isnotempty(Acao)
| summarize Estimativa=sum(Weight), Registros=count(), UltimoUTC=max(TimeGenerated) by Acao, ResultCode
| order by UltimoUTC desc
content.title: Login e ações sensíveis — evidência HTTP, não auditoria conclusiva
content.noDataMessage: Sem registros no período e escopo selecionados; isso não comprova ausência de incidentes.

content.query:
AppTraces | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where _ResourceId =~ '/subscriptions/7fd8132e-7c9a-4b4d-a191-04b21ecc968c/resourceGroups/carsync-dev/providers/microsoft.insights/components/appi-carsync-dev'
| where Message contains "SECURITY_VIOLATION" or Message contains "ANALYTICS_ACCESS" or Message contains "DATA_RETENTION"
| extend Familia=case(Message contains "SECURITY_VIOLATION", "SECURITY_VIOLATION", Message contains "ANALYTICS_ACCESS", "ANALYTICS_ACCESS", "DATA_RETENTION")
| extend Tipo=case(Message contains "Auth Failed", "Auth Failed", Message contains "Account Locked", "Account Locked", Message contains "Rate Limit Exceeded", "Rate Limit Exceeded", Message contains "JWT Wrong token type", "JWT Wrong token type", Message contains "JWT Invalid", "JWT Invalid", Message contains "Invalid Token", "Invalid Token", Message contains "Token Expired", "Token Expired", Message contains "purge completed", "purge completed", Message contains "anonymization completed", "anonymization completed", Familia)
| project HorarioUTC=TimeGenerated, Familia, Tipo, SeverityLevel
| top 100 by HorarioUTC desc
content.title: Eventos sanitizados — últimos 100 registros observados
content.noDataMessage: Sem registros no período e escopo selecionados; isso não comprova ausência de incidentes.
